rows.text: 设备上报温度，超过 80 度调用告警接口，否则记录一条正常日志
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"t1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"温度消息","config":{}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"超温判断","config":{"expression":"t1.payload.temp > 80"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"告警","config":{"url":"https://example.com/alarm","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"temp\":\"{{t1.payload.temp}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"d1","type":"code","name":"记录正常日志","config":{"expression":"\"normal log: temp=\" + t1.payload.temp"}}],"edges":[{"source":"t1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"d1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 收到订单消息后先等待 5 秒，再调用库存扣减接口，库存不足就记录错误
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"o1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"订单消息","config":{}},{"id":"d1","type":"delay","name":"等待5秒","config":{"delayMs":5000}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"库存检查","config":{"expression":"h1.status != 200"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"库存扣减","config":{"url":"https://example.com/inventory/deduct","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{{o1.payload}}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"cd1","type":"code","name":"记录错误","config":{"expression":"\"库存不足: \" + o1.payload.orderId"}}],"edges":[{"source":"o1","target":"d1"},{"source":"d1","target":"h1"},{"source":"h1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"cd1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"cd1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 每分钟检查一次服务健康状态，健康则继续，异常则调用告警回调
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","type":"http","name":"检查健康状态","config":{"url":"https://example.com/health","method":"GET","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"健康判断","config":{"expression":"n1.status == 200"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"告警回调","config":{"url":"https://example.com/callback","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"status\":\"unhealthy\",\"code\":\"{{n1.status}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"d1","type":"delay","name":"等待一分钟","config":{"delayMs":60000}}],"edges":[{"source":"n1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"d1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"false"},{"source":"h1","target":"d1"}]}

rows.text: 先调用 A 接口获取用户信息，再调用 B 接口拉取订单，最后让智能排查订单异常原因

nodes.name: 智能排查订单异常原因

rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","type":"http","name":"获取用户信息","config":{"url":"A","method":"GET","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"n2","type":"http","name":"拉取订单","config":{"url":"B","method":"GET","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"n3","type":"agent","name":"智能排查订单异常原因","config":{"task":"排查订单异常原因","constraints":{}}}],"edges":[{"source":"n1","target":"n2"},{"source":"n2","target":"n3"}]}

rows.text: 设备离线超过 10 分钟就发通知给运维，未超过则忽略
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"m1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"设备状态","config":{}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"离线超时判断","config":{"expression":"m1.payload.offlineDuration > 600000"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"发送运维通知","config":{"url":"https://example.com/notify","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"message\":\"Device offline for over 10 minutes: {{m1.payload.deviceId}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}}],"edges":[{"source":"m1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 收到支付成功消息后，先调用发票服务，然后延时 2 秒再推送消息给客户
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"p1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"支付成功消息","config":{}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"调用发票服务","config":{"url":"https://example.com/invoice","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{{p1.payload}}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"d1","type":"delay","name":"延时2秒","config":{"delayMs":2000}},{"id":"h2","type":"http","name":"推送消息给客户","config":{"url":"https://example.com/notify","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{{p1.payload}}","timeoutMs":10000}}],"edges":[{"source":"p1","target":"h1"},{"source":"h1","target":"d1"},{"source":"d1","target":"h2"}]}

rows.text: 采集到的电压低于 200 时触发降压告警，高于 240 时触发过压告警，其余情况记录
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"m1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"电压消息","config":{}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"电压判断","config":{"expression":"m1.payload.voltage < 200"}},{"id":"c2","type":"condition","name":"过压判断","config":{"expression":"m1.payload.voltage > 240"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"降压告警","config":{"url":"https://example.com/alarm","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"type\":\"under_voltage\",\"voltage\":\"{{m1.payload.voltage}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"h2","type":"http","name":"过压告警","config":{"url":"https://example.com/alarm","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"type\":\"over_voltage\",\"voltage\":\"{{m1.payload.voltage}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"d1","type":"code","name":"记录电压","config":{"expression":"m1.payload.voltage"}}],"edges":[{"source":"m1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"c2","branch":"false"},{"source":"c2","target":"h2","branch":"true"},{"source":"c2","target":"d1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 用户注册完成后，调用短信服务发送欢迎短信，失败重试

rows.text: 先调用天气接口，温度低于 5 度就调用供暖控制接口，否则记录温度
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","type":"http","name":"查询天气","config":{"url":"https://example.com/weather","method":"GET","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"低温判断","config":{"expression":"n1.response.temperature < 5"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"供暖控制","config":{"url":"https://example.com/heating","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"action\":\"enable\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"d1","type":"code","name":"记录温度","config":{"expression":"n1.response.temperature"}}],"edges":[{"source":"n1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"d1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 订单金额大于 1000 元走人工审核接口，否则自动通过
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"订单消息","config":{}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"金额判断","config":{"expression":"n1.payload.amount > 1000"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"人工审核","config":{"url":"https://example.com/review","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"order_id\":\"{{n1.payload.order_id}}\",\"amount\":\"{{n1.payload.amount}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"d1","type":"code","name":"自动通过","config":{"expression":"{status: 'approved', order_id: n1.payload.order_id}"}}],"edges":[{"source":"n1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"d1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 收到传感器数据后，让智能体分析是否需要维修，需要则调用派单接口
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"s1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"传感器数据","config":{}},{"id":"a1","type":"agent","name":"维修分析","config":{"task":"分析传感器数据是否需要维修","constraints":{}}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"需维修判断","config":{"expression":"a1.result == 'yes'"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"派单","config":{"url":"https://example.com/dispatch","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{{a1.result}}","timeoutMs":10000}}],"edges":[{"source":"s1","target":"a1"},{"source":"a1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 设备上报湿度，超过 90 调用除湿机接口，30 到 90 之间记录数据
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"m1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"湿度消息","config":{}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"湿度判断","config":{"expression":"m1.payload.humidity > 90"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"启动除湿机","config":{"url":"https://example.com/dehumidify","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"humidity\":\"{{m1.payload.humidity}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"c2","type":"condition","name":"中湿度判断","config":{"expression":"m1.payload.humidity >= 30 && m1.payload.humidity <= 90"}},{"id":"d1","type":"code","name":"记录湿度数据","config":{"expression":"m1.payload.humidity"}}],"edges":[{"source":"m1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"c2","branch":"false"},{"source":"c2","target":"d1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c2","target":"d1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 每天定时拉取销售数据，拉取失败则等待 10 秒后重试

rows.text: 调用设备状态接口，返回离线则调用重启接口
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","type":"http","name":"查询设备状态","config":{"url":"https://example.com/device/status","method":"GET","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"判断是否离线","config":{"expression":"n1.response.body.status == 'offline'"}},{"id":"n2","type":"http","name":"重启设备","config":{"url":"https://example.com/device/restart","method":"POST","timeoutMs":10000}}],"edges":[{"source":"n1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"n2","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"n2","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 先等待 3 秒，再调用外部接口提交工单，提交成功后记录工单号
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"d1","type":"delay","name":"等待3秒","config":{"delayMs":3000}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"提交工单","config":{"url":"https://example.com/ticket","method":"POST","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"c1","type":"code","name":"记录工单号","config":{"expression":"h1.body.id"}}],"edges":[{"source":"d1","target":"h1"},{"source":"h1","target":"c1"}]}

rows.text: 收到消息后判断等级是否为 P0，是则立即调用电话告警接口，否则记录
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"m1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"消息接收","config":{}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"P0等级判断","config":{"expression":"m1.payload.level == 'P0'"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"电话告警","config":{"url":"https://example.com/phone-alarm","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"level\":\"{{m1.payload.level}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"d1","type":"code","name":"记录","config":{"expression":"m1.payload"}}],"edges":[{"source":"m1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"d1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 拉取库存接口，库存小于 10 调用补货接口，否则记录库存
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","type":"http","name":"拉取库存","config":{"url":"https://example.com/inventory","method":"GET","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"库存判断","config":{"expression":"n1.response.body.stock < 10"}},{"id":"h1","type":"http","name":"补货","config":{"url":"https://example.com/restock","method":"POST","bodyTemplate":"{\"stock\":\"{{n1.response.body.stock}}\"}","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"d1","type":"code","name":"记录库存","config":{"expression":"n1.response.body.stock"}}],"edges":[{"source":"n1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"h1","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"d1","branch":"false"}]}

rows.text: 把设备上报的数据交给智能体做异常诊断，输出诊断报告
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","type":"mqtt-trigger","name":"设备数据","config":{}},{"id":"a1","type":"agent","name":"异常诊断","config":{"task":"对设备上报的数据进行异常诊断，输出诊断报告","constraints":{}}}],"edges":[{"source":"n1","target":"a1"}]}

rows.text: 先调用登录校验接口，失败则直接结束，成功则继续调用数据查询接口
rows.dslJson: {"nodes":[{"id":"n1","type":"http","name":"登录校验","config":{"url":"https://example.com/login","method":"POST","timeoutMs":10000}},{"id":"c1","type":"condition","name":"校验成功判断","config":{"expression":"n1.status == 200"}},{"id":"n2","type":"http","name":"数据查询","config":{"url":"https://example.com/data","method":"GET","timeoutMs":10000}}],"edges":[{"source":"n1","target":"c1"},{"source":"c1","target":"n2","branch":"true"},{"source":"c1","target":"n2","branch":"false"}]}
